recipes.title: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Blistered crust, bright tomato sauce and creamy mozzarella — the Neapolitan classic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250°C (480°F) with a baking tray inside.
Stretch the dough into two thin rounds on parchment paper.
Spread crushed tomatoes over the dough, season with salt and drizzle with olive oil.
Slide onto the hot tray and bake for 8–10 minutes until the crust is blistered.
Top with torn mozzarella and basil, then bake 1 more minute.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
recipes.description: Filipino braised chicken in a tangy, garlicky soy-vinegar sauce.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce and crushed garlic for 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in oil until browned on both sides.
Add the marinade, vinegar, bay leaves and peppercorns.
Simmer uncovered for 35 minutes until the sauce reduces and thickens.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Vegan Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: A weeknight coconut curry with chickpeas and wilted spinach.
instructions: Sauté the diced onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Silky egg-and-pecorino sauce, crisp guanciale and plenty of black pepper.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente.
Render the guanciale in a pan until crisp, then turn off the heat.
Whisk the eggs with grated pecorino and pepper.
Toss the hot pasta with the guanciale, then stir in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water until creamy.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy cucumber, ripe tomato, olives and a slab of feta.
instructions: Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and onion into chunky pieces.
Combine with olives in a wide bowl.
Place the feta on top and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle with oregano and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes sweetened only by ripe bananas.
instructions: Mash the bananas until smooth.
Whisk in the eggs and milk.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 more minute.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef on warm corn tortillas with fresh toppings.
instructions: Brown the beef in a skillet, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the seasoning and 60 ml of water; simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas on a dry pan until pliable.
Fill with beef and top with lettuce, tomato and cheese. Serve with lime.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice with browned mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms until golden, then set aside.
Soften the diced onion in butter, add the rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Fold in the mushrooms, remaining butter and parmesan.

recipes.title: Lemon Dill Salmon
recipes.description: Oven-baked salmon fillets with garlic, lemon and fresh dill.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a tray with parchment.
Rub the salmon with olive oil, minced garlic and salt.
Top with lemon slices and dill.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the fish flakes easily.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
recipes.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tamarind sauce and crushed peanuts.
instructions: Soak the noodles in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Mix the tamarind paste and fish sauce into a sauce.
Stir-fry the shrimp in hot oil, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss until coated.
Serve topped with bean sprouts and crushed peanuts.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A warming, lemony lentil soup that comes together in 35 minutes.
instructions: Sauté the onion, carrots and garlic in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, then add the lentils and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend about half of the soup for a creamy texture and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Crisp-edged, chewy-centred cookies loaded with chocolate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cream the butter with both sugars until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda and salt, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop onto lined trays and bake for 10–12 minutes. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.
